title: 1 极乐2 我   是谁
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: “舍...舍...舍利弗，彼土何故名为极乐？”
“其国众生无有众苦，但受诸乐，故名极乐。其国七重栏楯、七重罗网、七重行树，皆是四宝周匝围绕，是故...是故...彼国名为极乐。”
读经声有些颤抖。
读经人一边读，一边看着面前的镜子。
一个办公楼尽头公厕的镜子。
镜子里倒映出一个西装革履的青年模样。
今日夜班是他和同事调班的。
因为，这是他苦苦求来的生门。
农历七月十五，午夜对镜诵《阿弥陀极乐经》，可得一线生机。
为何要求这生机？
因为，他撞鬼了！
他从不信鬼神，可在亲身经历了一些诸如“门外血手印”、“半夜弹珠声”、“窗缝里没有眼白的眸子”、“衣柜里挂着的惨白腐衣”之类的事情后，他信了...
然后他病急乱投医，在街头寻了个说他有血光之灾的大和尚，然后遵循那和尚所言，于农历七月十五午夜，来到了此间公厕，对着镜子...诵读此经。
他的手已经在抖。
他的喉结不停滚动，咽着口水。
他的眼珠死死盯着镜子里面庞惨白的青年。
他的呼吸很快，快到像是强劲的负压风扇正卷起高压的狂风，要把他的心脏从胸腔里吸出，然后从嗓子眼血淋淋地抛出去。
忽然...
他瞳孔紧缩了起来，慢慢显出不敢置信之色。
镜子中...
他的身后...
出现了一只狗。
一只两米高的白狗。
这种诡异的时候，他反倒是冷静下来，语气平稳地继续诵读经文。
然而，那白狗却猛然扑来，从后一下死死咬住了他的脖子。
咔擦！！
大口大口的喘气声里，李玄猛然睁开了眼。
强烈的虚弱感，全身四肢冰凉之感瞬间传来，可是他怀里却有一团软香的温热，像个小太阳一样在源源不断地传来热气，隔着肌肤将那些热气送入他四肢百骸。
他下意识地抱紧那小太阳。
小太阳发出女人的声音，有些软糯。
“玄郎，你醒啦，你终于醒啦！呜呜呜...”
然后，女人继续缠紧他，喉间喷出热气，“抱紧我，家里没炭了，你抱紧我暖和，我身子骨热...我耐寒。抱紧我，快，快点！玄郎，你吃了药，会没事的，就当是一场寒疾...”
content_en:
"Sari... Sariputra, why is that land called bliss?"
"The sentient beings in that country do not suffer all kinds of suffering, but they enjoy all kinds of happiness, so it is called Utmost Bliss. Its country has seven layers of railings, seven layers of nets, and seven layers of rows of trees, all surrounded by four treasures. That's why...that's why...that country is called Utmost Bliss."
The sound of reading the Bible was trembling.
As the reader reads, he looks in the mirror in front of him.
A mirror in a public toilet at the end of an office building.
The mirror reflected the appearance of a young man in a suit and leather shoes.
He and his colleagues transferred the night shift today.
Because this is the life he has been praying for.
On the fifteenth day of the seventh lunar month, recite the Amitabha Sutra in front of the mirror at midnight to get a glimmer of hope.
Why do you ask for this life?
Because he hit a ghost!
He never believed in ghosts and gods, but after personally experiencing things such as "bloody handprints outside the door", "the sound of marbles in the middle of the night", "eyes without whites in the window cracks", "pale rotten clothes hanging in the closet", he believed...
Then he became seriously ill and sought medical treatment. He found a great monk on the street who said he had suffered a bloody disaster. Then he followed the monk's advice and went to the public restroom at midnight on the 15th day of the seventh lunar month and recited this sutra in front of the mirror.
His hands were already shaking.
His Adam's apple rolled and he swallowed.
His eyes were fixed on the pale young man in the mirror.
His breathing was so fast that it was as if a powerful negative pressure fan was whipping up high-pressure wind to suck his heart out of his chest and then throw it bloody out of his throat.
suddenly...
His pupils tightened, slowly showing disbelief.
In the mirror...
Behind him...
A dog appears.
A two-meter-tall white dog.
In this strange situation, he calmed down and continued to recite scriptures in a calm tone.
However, the white dog suddenly pounced on him and bit his neck from behind.
Click! !

"Hoo! Hoo!!! Hoo ho~~~"
Li Xuan suddenly opened his eyes while gasping for air.
A strong feeling of weakness and a cold feeling in his whole body and limbs instantly came over him, but there was a soft and fragrant warmth in his arms, like a small sun that continuously sent heat, sending the heat into his limbs through his skin.
He subconsciously hugged the little sun tightly.
Little Sun made a woman's voice, which was a little soft.
"Xuanlang, you're awake, you're finally awake! Wuwuwu..."
Then, the woman continued to wrap her arms around him, hot air spurting out from her throat, "Hold me tight, there is no more charcoal in the house, hold me tight to keep me warm, my body is bone-heated...I can withstand the cold. Hold me tight, hurry up, hurry up! Xuanlang, you take the medicine, you will be fine, just treat it like a cold illness..."
